sql.if: AND (h.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR h.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: SELECT h.id, h.name, h.address, h.star, h.score, h.img_url, h.status, h.business_id, h.create_time, m.merchant_name, (SELECT MIN(r.price) FROM room r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id AND r.status = '0') AS min_price, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id) AS room_count FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN merchant m ON h.business_id = m.id WHERE h.status = '0'

sql.if: AND (h.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR h.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND (SELECT MIN(r.price) FROM room r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id) >= #{query.minPrice}
AND (SELECT MIN(r.price) FROM room r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id) <= #{query.maxPrice}

mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.name, h.address, h.star, h.score, h.img_url, h.facility, h.business_id, h.status, h.create_time, h.update_time, m.merchant_name FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN merchant m ON h.business_id = m.id WHERE h.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hotel h WHERE 1=1

SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(h.address, '市', 1)) AS city_name, COUNT(*) AS hotel_count FROM hotel h WHERE h.status = '0' AND h.address LIKE '%市%' GROUP BY city_name ORDER BY hotel_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
ORDER BY h.score DESC, h.star DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.id, h.name, h.address, h.star, h.score, h.img_url, h.status, h.business_id, h.create_time, m.merchant_name, (SELECT MIN(r.price) FROM room r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id AND r.status = '0') AS min_price, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id) AS room_count FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN merchant m ON h.business_id = m.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT h2.star FROM hotel h2 INNER JOIN orders o2 ON h2.id = o2.hotel_id WHERE o2.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h2.star DESC LIMIT 2 ) ps ON h.star = ps.star WHERE h.status = '0' AND h.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.hotel_id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.hotel_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY h.score DESC, h.star DESC LIMIT #{limit}
